notes.title: PERFECT ANGLE - NEW MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Celebrating the release of the PlayStaion 4 and Nintendo swicth versions we have prepared an major update with all the improvements you have requested. Thanks for the feedback!
- Are you stuck? Now you have a free hint every 2 minutes. No more DLC's.
- Redesigned the interface and controls to be used more comfortably.
- Removed all references to other games in the city.
- Improved music and sounds.
